detail.longDescription: 🐦 TIL: Across 5 European countries, matched male and female researchers walked toward # birds in parks and green spaces. On average, men got about one meter closer before the birds flew off. The pattern held in # Czechia , # France , # Germany , # Poland , and # Spain , across all 37 species checked, from # magpies to # pigeons . Researchers agree that the birds distinguish men from women but can't yet say why. 👉 https://www. sciencedaily.com/releases/2026 /10/261021231250.htm # behavior # ecology # science # research # cities # sparrows # blackbirds # wildlife # flight # europe # biology # nature # animals
